verdict.rationale: ClickHouse exposes programmatic surfaces that cover much of what a console user would do. An OpenAPI spec is published (probe-3). The official clickhousectl CLI can create and manage Cloud clusters, Postgres services, ClickPipes and other Cloud resources. An HTTP query interface and an official MCP server round this out. missing for 10: an explicit statement or documentation of API/UI feature parity, details of what the OpenAPI spec actually covers, and independent or hands-on confirmation that every UI action is reachable via API.
